name: WHO publications and IRIS

licensing: WHO website copyright terms allow attributed extracts for research/private study, not sale or commercial use. Substantial reproduction/translation and other uses need permission. WHO publication Open Access policy is separate and must be checked per item.
limitations: No current verified item-query examples. Catalog identity and documentation do not establish qualification.
Reading availability, jurisdiction, language, native version identity and machine-use limits remain open.
next_action: Review IRIS and WHO terms, establish permitted query/export and publication-version identifiers, and separate free online reading from book-order prices and translation rights.

rights_and_cost.summary: Current publication and copyright policies distinguish WHO publications, external articles/chapters and classification data. Non-commercial and third-party restrictions, a date boundary and differing overview wording prevent blanket clearance.

facts.website_terms: WHO website copyright terms allow attributed extracts for research/private study, not sale or commercial use. Substantial reproduction/translation and other uses need permission. WHO publication Open Access policy is separate and must be checked per item.

publication_policy.WHO_published: Since 12 November 2016, CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO; policy says pre-2017 works not reissued automatically under it. Verify individual item notices, especially the 2016 date boundary.
publication_policy.WHO_authored_articles: Open-access policy says CC BY 3.0 IGO and repository deposit by publication; accepted manuscript and version of record are distinct.
publication_policy.WHO_funded_articles: Open-access policy says CC BY 4.0; copyright overview instead broadly groups externally published funded/authored outputs under CC BY/CC BY-NC 3.0 IGO. Retain this inconsistency and defer to item license.
publication_policy.chapters: CC BY or CC BY-NC 3.0 IGO, deposit as soon as possible and within 12 months; not guaranteed immediate reading.
publication_policy.third_party_material: Originating publisher permission may be needed; site-wide/publication label does not clear every component.
publication_policy.commercial: WHO publication commercial reuse requires permission; no outreach submitted.
publication_policy.classification_exception: ICD/ICF/ICHI have separate CC BY-ND 3.0 IGO terms, with registered API. Separate service lead, no account or classification queries.

open_questions: Check each representative item license and metadata-reuse allowance; reconcile policy wording before commercial use.
